observations: Precedence proven live: explicit byRole rules decided GROOVE and BASS (source=operator); the ensemble TRANSITION track had no explicit rule, so the brain chose (source=brain) and outranked the table default, as designed.

With one attested, undeclared instrument the brain can only say 'universal instrument'; the musical scoring (families/roles/character) needs the operator to attest and describe more instruments (.vstpreset for HALion Sonic / Groove Agent SE / Padshop, `make_manifest.py --character ...`).

Found on the way: GET /projects/{id}/artifacts returned 500 (ZodError) for any project with a completed export, because the OpenAPI Artifact.type enum lacked PREMASTER/METADATA/BUNDLE while the export job persists those types. Enum aligned with ExportFile.type; clients regenerated.
No StyleProfile was attached to this export (Wave U persistence lands with PR-U2); the sound dimensions path is covered by unit tests only.
